PROJECT.NAME: CampusEats MEC
PROJECT.TYPE: Campus-exclusive food ordering and payment web platform
PROJECT.SCOPE: Fully functional frontend, backend, authentication, and database with production-grade UI, animations, and smooth interactions.

MASTER_PROMPT.CORE_OBJECTIVE: Build a Swiggy / UberEats–level food ordering experience for a college campus where interface quality, smooth motion, and usability are treated as first-class requirements. The system must feel premium, calm, modern, and highly interactive.

TECH_STACK.FRONTEND: Modern component-based web framework Mobile-first responsive design GPU-accelerated animations Support for advanced motion libraries

DESIGN_LANGUAGE.COLOR_SYSTEM: Soft pastel palette only Peach, cream, mint, sage, muted orange No harsh contrast, no neon, no deep blacks
DESIGN_LANGUAGE.LAYOUT: Card-based UI Floating sections Rounded corners Soft shadows Generous spacing
DESIGN_LANGUAGE.VISUAL_DEPTH: Subtle elevation Light blur Gentle glassmorphism accents

MOTION_AND_INTERACTION.PAGE_TRANSITIONS: Smooth fade and slide Natural easing curves No abrupt cuts
MOTION_AND_INTERACTION.MICRO_INTERACTIONS: Hover lift with shadow Button ripple or pulse Add-to-cart pop animation Quantity increment soft bounce
MOTION_AND_INTERACTION.CONTENT_ANIMATION: Staggered menu item entry Smooth horizontal category scroll Floating card appearance
MOTION_AND_INTERACTION.LOGIN_EFFECTS: Calm entry animation Success pulse on authentication
MOTION_AND_INTERACTION.SOUND_FEEDBACK: Very subtle click sounds Order placed confirmation Pickup confirmation

APPLICATION_PAGES.HOME: Professional food-app homepage Hero section Category carousel Featured items Live availability indicators
APPLICATION_PAGES.MENU: Animated food cards Hover effects Availability badges Group order indicators
APPLICATION_PAGES.CART_AND_CHECKOUT: Clean order summary Animated transitions Payment mode selector Confirmation animation
APPLICATION_PAGES.ORDER_STATUS: Visual progress indicator Pickup prompt Calm success feedback

PORTALS.STUDENT_PORTAL: Dashboard Wallet balance card Order history timeline
PORTALS.VENDOR_PORTAL: Minimal and fast UI Live order queue One-tap status updates
PORTALS.ADMIN_PORTAL: Clean tables Soft analytics visuals Professional management interface

BUSINESS_LOGIC.ORDER_FLOW: Student places order Vendor accepts order Vendor marks order ready Pickup confirmation required Payment deducted only after pickup

PAYMENT_SYSTEM.RFID: Each student linked to a unique RFID UID Wallet balance tied to RFID Deduction occurs only after successful pickup
PAYMENT_SYSTEM.QR_PAYMENT: Demo QR / UPI fallback Used if RFID unavailable

BUSINESS_LOGIC.GROUP_ORDERING: Allow multiple students to link orders Orders bundled for preparation Food served together

DATABASE_STRUCTURE.COLLECTION: order_id user_id vendor_id items status payment_method created_at picked_up_at
transaction_id order_id user_id amount method timestamp

MASTER_PROMPT.SECURITY_RULES: Role-based access enforcement Wallet mutations allowed only via backend logic Order state locked after pickup confirmation
MASTER_PROMPT.QUALITY_EXPECTATION: The final system must feel premium, fluid, and modern. Interface smoothness and animation quality are as important as functionality. No feature is considered complete unless it feels polished.
